How it works:
1. Pair your WH-1000XM6 (or XM5) with your phone 2. Select it from the dropdown above 3. Tap "Start Service" 4. When you play media → ANC turns on 5. When you pause → Ambient sound mode engages
The service runs in the background until you stop it.
Protocol: MDR framing over Bluetooth RFCOMM (service UUID 956c7b26-…) Originally reverse-engineered by Gadgetbridge.
